name: @hpro/app
description: hpro Reader als Web-App (PWA): öffnen, fließend und seitengetreu lesen, Inhaltsverzeichnis, Suche, Zoom, offline

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.sw.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && vitest run && vite build && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e: PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.browsers playwright install --only-shell chromium && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=.browsers playwright test --project=chromium
scripts.belege: vite build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$PWD/.browsers playwright test --project=belege e2e/belege.spec.ts
scripts.belege:p19: vite build && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=$PWD/.browsers playwright test --project=belege e2e/p19-belege.spec.ts
